semiconductor_relevance: Medium — while the company is involved in the semiconductor industry through agency sales of materials and equipment, it does not appear to manufacture or develop semiconductor-specific products.
summary: Topco Scientific (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. operates as an agency for materials and equipment in the semiconductor and related industries, providing system integration and environmental engineering services. The company focuses on customer satisfaction and innovation, aiming to expand its global operational capabilities.
capabilities: Agency sales of semiconductor materials and equipment

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shanghai and is actively expanding its market presence both domestically and internationally.
